note: Corps of Engineers campground at the tip of a wooded peninsula on Pomme de Terre Lake, off RB Highway east of Highway 83 near Flemington. Gravel back-in and pull-through pads in two loops under open oaks, many with the lake in view; boat ramp with courtesy dock at the point. Check in at the attendant booth on arrival. --Claude
summary: Confirmed (lakeview kept, no site earns lakefront). Fees 16-26 kept with a peak span; 50A/water/no sewer, 35 sites (max 45 ft, 6 pull-throughs), showers/flush/dump, season Mar 15 - Nov 30 (shoulder electric-only) and rec.gov-only booking with no FCFS now manual. PIN moves ~700 m north to the campground (flag); phone 417-282-6890 added (flag).
flags: PIN (move ~700 m): stored 37.8261,-93.3614 is on the park road in open mowed ground ~650-700 m south of the campground. The catalog's 35 site coordinates all sit on the peninsula tip (37.8313-37.8331, -93.3627 to -93.3650), and imagery shows the two gravel loops there beside the boat ramp. Move to 37.8322,-93.3640 (the loop entrance at the ramp parking).

WATERFRONT (lakeview kept; no lakefront): summer site photos of 01, 02, 13, 16, 25 and 29 all show the lake through the trees, and on imagery with the catalog coordinates the outer sites (03, 05, 12, 16, 26-29) are ~25-50 m from the shore. But the ground between is a wooded bank under mature oaks (grass understory, railed overlooks at some pad ends), and the closest sites (03, 05) are on the east loop's treed bluff edge, so none has the open apron that lakefront needs. Site 16 comes closest (grass and an overlook deck, ~45-50 m) - not enough to raise.
PHONE (missing): rec.gov facility phone 417-282-6890 - add it.

FEES CONFLICT (shoulder): rec.gov's rate table has 2027 off-peak (Oct 1 - Nov 30) STANDARD ELECTRIC $16, while the site notice says the electric-only off-season is '$10 per night' (Mar 15 - Apr 15, Oct 1 - Nov 30). Written $16 as the low from the rate table. Recreation.gov's calendar returned no nights at all for Nov 2026, Mar 2027 or Apr 1-15 2027, and the notices say 'no first-come-first-serve window', so whether the shoulder is actually sold anywhere is unclear.

rec.gov rules also carry militaryDiscount 1 ('Military Discount') and maxStay 28 nights per rolling 30 days. Additional camping units are charged extra (notice). America the Beautiful passes must be shown at check-in.
